name: A Hot Night With My Boss in a Capsule Hotel
original_name: 終電後、カプセルホテルで、上司に微熱伝わる夜。
overview: The anime centers on Minori, an office worker, and her boss Hadano, who are constantly arguing with each other. One night, after a company drinking party, Minori and Hadano are having their usual argument, when Minori realizes that she has missed the last train. They decide to spend the night at a nearby capsule hotel, but an incident forces them to share the same unit.  (Source: ANN)
